strings.name: Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone
strings.summary: Raised in New Jersey, McLaughlin-Levrone made the Olympics as a teenager and turned professional after attending Kentucky. She won 400m hurdles gold in Tokyo and Paris, repeatedly breaking the world record, including 50.37 in 2024, and shared relay titles. In 2025 she focused on the flat 400m and won the world title, demonstrating her range across hurdles and sprinting.
